latest_release.body:
## New Features

- Added OCR plugin functionality; go to Settings > Plugins
- Added support for the following file formats: caj, djvu, xps, chm, doc, rtf, pptx, ppt, ofd, djv, oxps, and ofd
- The reading page now supports an immersive title bar, which automatically hides while reading
- Reading options now support grouped display
- Added book collections and grouping features, allowing you to combine and manage multiple books together
- Support for adjusting page spacing in double-page view; go to Reading Options on the right > Layout
- Support for right-to-left page turning; go to Reading Options on the right > Layout
- Support for exporting book packages: Book files, along with notes, highlights, bookmarks, and dictionary history, are bundled into a single new file for easy sharing with others or importing onto new devices
- Added a prompt asking whether to clear all data upon uninstallation
- Support for parsing ISBN, publication date, modification date, language, and other information from book files
- Optimized for comics in EPUB, MOBI, and AZW3 formats, with support for double-page mode and continuous scrolling
- Added an auto-read feature that automatically scrolls pages at a specified speed; tap the “Assisted Reading” button in the top-right corner
- Added options to clear temporary cache and TTS cache; go to Settings > Data
- Added a pop-up prompt before opening external links
- Support for hiding the built-in background in text-only PDFs
- Support for clearing all keyboard shortcuts
- Optimized chapter division rules for TXT files
- (Mobile) Reading settings are divided into Basic Settings and Advanced Settings; Advanced Settings now support grouped display
- (Mobile) Added support for MEGA cloud storage
- (Mobile) Added an option to automatically adjust reading brightness
- (Mobile) The native PDF reader and comic reader now support page turning via volume keys
- (Mobile) Added Data Management to Settings, which displays cache and total data sizes
- (Mobile) Added support for adjusting the threshold for automatically clearing temporary cache; go to Settings > Data Management
- (Mobile) Added support for clearing the TTS cache; go to Settings > Data Management
- (Mobile) Added an overlay animation for page-turning
- (Mobile) Sorting by book title now supports sorting by numerical order
- (Mobile) Added support for djvu, xps, chm, doc, rtf, pptx, ppt, ofd, djv, oxps, and ofd file formats
- (Mobile) Added book collections and grouping features, allowing you to merge and manage multiple books together
- (Mobile) Added support for adjusting page spacing in two-page view. Please click the setting button in the reading page
- (Mobile) Added support for right-to-left page turning. Please click the setting button in the reading page
- (Mobile) Added support for parsing ISBN, publication date, modification date, language, and other information from book files
- (Mobile) Optimized support for comics in EPUB, MOBI, and AZW3 formats, with support for double-page mode and continuous scrolling
- (Mobile) Added support for hiding the built-in background in text-only PDFs
- (Mobile) Optimized chapter division rules for TXT files

## Fixes
- Fixed an issue where content in some books was obscured in both single-page and two-page modes
- Fixed import and rendering issues for some CBZ and CBR format books
- Fixed an issue where some AI providers could not retrieve the model list
- Fixed a security vulnerability in directory traversal for the Docker version of OPDS
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where audiobooks could not be played in the background for extended periods after the screen was locked (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the bookmark list in the native PDF reader and comic reader was empty
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where the scope of text rules could not be set
- (Mobile) Fixed an issue where content in some books was obscured in single-page and double-page modes
- (Mobile) Fixed import and
